newsitem.title: USA: NYSE says to resume Centennial Tech trading. [CORRECTED 16:25 GMT]
newsitem.headline: NYSE says to resume Centennial Tech trading. [CORRECTED 16:25 GMT]

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange said it expected to resume "regular-way" trading of Centennial Technologies Inc common stock Thursday.

The NYSE said trading in the stock would be on a "cash basis and regular way" (NYSE corrects from "cash-only basis") on Friday, "in view of the NYSE's previously announced plan to suspend the stock prior to the opening of trading on Monday, March 3."
Shares closed at 14-3/4 on February 25 on the NYSE.

Centennial said earlier today that it would restate financial results for fiscal years 1994, 1995, and 1996 and the first two quarters of fiscal 1997, and expects to report "material cumulative losses" for the period.
In cash-only trading, securities must be delivered on the same day, while with regular-way, there are three days to deliver the securities.
